mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen in each of the last four weeks, and this negative momentum persists: the four-week mean over the next 28 days will be lower than the last 28-day mean. The mechanism is autocorrelated footfall decline under sustained restrictions.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined from -16.1 to -29.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -25 percent for two consecutive weeks, retail footfall follows transit-dependent trips downward, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -25 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while TRANSIT remains below -25 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in WORKPLACES indicates a shift to staying home and remote work; this combination reduces retail-and-recreation trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose to 13.7 while WORKPLACES fell to -19.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days when RESIDENTIAL is above +10 and WORKPLACES is below -15.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, a fall in PARKS below -20 signals reduced outdoor activity and broader containment, which spills over into lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: In a tightening-restrictions regime, RETAIL_REC rises when PARKS has fallen below -20.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM at elevated levels reflects stockpiling that substitutes for retail trips; as GROCERY_PHARM falls from its peak, displaced spending rotates back into retail, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +20 after being above +25
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next 14 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays below +20.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal downturn captured by the four-week RETAIL_REC decline continues for at least one more week, so the next 7-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 7-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:last weekly RETAIL_REC was -29.1, the lowest of the four weeks
failure_condition: The next 7-day mean RETAIL_REC is higher than the last 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Remote-work mandates reduce WORKPLACES and TRANSIT simultaneously; this dual decline removes commuter and leisure trips that feed retail, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -19.9 and TRANSIT to -27.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both remain below -15.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds +12 percent, home stays suppress discretionary retail trips, causing RETAIL_REC to fall further over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL reached 13.7 in the last week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above +12.
